title: Create deal
$sideEffectsComment: HubSpot has no idempotency key, so a retry creates a SECOND deal. Declared unsafe, so a host must not replay it blindly.

constants.$comment: Required by HubSpot's create schema and empty for a plain create, as in contact_create.

config.label: Properties
config.description: HubSpot property name → value for the new deal. Values are sent as strings, which is how HubSpot stores every property.

outputShape.description: HubSpot's deal id. A NUMERIC STRING, not a number; pass it back as given.
The requested properties, every value a string or null.
